description: This file contains the implementation of the Drupal Router class, which extends URL matching capabilities and handles route matching, filtering, and enhancement within Drupal's routing system.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Routing\Router
classes.description: A Drupal-specific implementation of a URL router that extends Symfony's UrlMatcher, providing route matching, filtering, and enhancement functionalities.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Creates a Request object from a path info string and delegates to matchRequest.

methods.name: matchRequest
methods.description: Matches a given Request object to a route collection, applying filters and enhancers.

methods.name: matchCollection
methods.description: Attempts to match a URL path against a collection of routes, supporting case sensitivity options.

methods.name: doMatchCollection
methods.description: Performs the core matching logic for a URL against individual routes, considering regex, host, and HTTP method.

methods.name: getInitialRouteCollection
methods.description: Retrieves the initial set of routes for a request from the route provider.

methods.name: applyRouteEnhancers
methods.description: Applies route enhancers to the matched route defaults.

methods.name: applyRouteFilters
methods.description: Filters a route collection based on request criteria.

methods.name: applyFitOrder
methods.description: Reorders route collection based on route fit priorities.

methods.name: getRouteCollection
methods.description: Returns a lazy route collection for the route provider.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Method not supported; throws exception advising to use Drupal\Core\Url instead.
